name: incidents_scribe
description: Writes an incident's short texts from its events only: the Now line people read first, and a status update for the lead to send. Reads nothing else and never acts.

context.description: From incidents_refresh or incidents_draft_update, as JSON: kind (now or update), the instruction for that kind, and the facts (the incident and its events).

text.description: The text asked for, plain sentences, nothing else.
